summary: Diff removes the admin/access-code gate from both frontend signup flow and backend signupWithRole checks, and removes related error-translation/validation logic. However, the diff also introduces new, unrequested signup requirements (a password field/validation) and adds a name-based admin allowlist that can elevate users to admin outside the requested scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a "Password" field to the signup completion form, with frontend-only validation (required + min length), even though the BuildRequest explicitly targets removing admin/access-code mechanisms and lists password-based authentication as a non-goal.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request adding any password field/validation to signup; it only requested removal of Admin Special Password/Access Code mechanisms.
evidence: frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx (adds password state, validation, and UI references: `const [password, setPassword] = useState('')`, `validateRequired(password, 'Password')`, `Password must be at least 6 characters`)
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (comment: "Ensure only UserProfile fields are sent to backend (no password field)")

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a hardcoded name-based admin allowlist that can assign admin privileges regardless of the requested role.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request any new admin allowlisting logic; it explicitly stated non-goals include changing role concepts beyond removing the secret-code gate.
evidence: backend/main.mo (`isAdminAllowlisted` hardcodes names; `determineAccessControlRole` elevates to `#admin` when allowlisted; `ensureAllowlistedAdminStatus` assigns admin role)
